_note: Image/text -> 3D (.glb) models on fal, called only through Broadcast's mesh-job proxy. Prices, input schemas, output fields and fal's licence tag read from each fal model page's llms.txt on 2026-11-12; recheck before budgeting. price_usd is the base call (with base_inputs); each option adds its usd and sets its inputs. status: ready = a paid pilot ran end to end here and the .glb fitted; untested = mapping written from the fal page, the first paid pilot must verify it; planned = listed, no mapping. Broadcast maps 'image', 'prompt', 'seed' through 'inputs' and reads the .glb URL at 'output' (dotted path in fal's result).

models.label: Meshy 7 (fal)

licence.summary: fal: commercial. Meshy ToU as for Meshy 6 (credit Meshy until confirmed)

models.notes: Endpoint id has no fal-ai/ prefix. $0.80 untextured, $1.20 textured (not $0.80 as first noted); fal lists a $1.40 'ultra mode' but no schema field for it, so it is not offered here. meshy/v7.1 exists at the same prices with geometry_resolution up to 4k.

models.label: Tripo v2.5 (fal)

licence.summary: fal: commercial. Tripo's own terms could not be read (403); reports say free plan CC BY 4.0, paid plans commercial; credit Tripo until confirmed

models.notes: $0.20 untextured / $0.30 standard texture / $0.40 HD. fal's price lists Style and quad at +$0.05 each, but Style has no schema field and quad forces FBX output, so neither is offered (we need .glb). text-to-3d page is a stub (unconfirmed); multiview-to-3d exists (front/left/back/right image urls).

licence.summary: fal: commercial. Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.0 Community License: territory excludes the EU, UK and South Korea; over 1M monthly users needs Tencent's licence; Tencent claims no rights in outputs

models.label: Hunyuan 3D 3.1 Rapid (fal)

licence.summary: fal: commercial. Hunyuan 3D 3.x is API-only (Tencent Cloud, no open weights); its output terms are unconfirmed

models.notes: Id uses 'hunyuan-3d' (with a hyphen). Text-to-3D exists (fal-ai/hunyuan-3d/v3.1/rapid/text-to-3d, prompt max 200 chars) but returns OBJ, not GLB, so text is off here. Image-to-3D returns GLB 'if available, otherwise OBJ': the proxy must fail the job (not charge twice) if no GLB comes back. No seed.
